description: Whenever the Attorney General has reasonable cause to believe that any person has engaged in, is engaging in, or is about to engage in any violation of this chapter, the Attorney General is empowered to issue a civil investigative demand. The provisions of § 59.1-9.10 shall apply mutatis mutandis (§ 59.1-583). The Attorney General may also request, pursuant to a civil investigative demand, that a controller disclose any data protection assessment relevant to an investigation (§ 59.1-580(D)).
